title: Travel Itinerary
key_sentences: All times shown are local times at each airport.
Your return flight on 9 November is waitlisted, and we will confirm it or rebook you by 30 October.
A driver from Acacia Park Hotel will meet you in the arrivals hall at Nairobi and hold a sign with your name.
Transfers in Kigali are not included and can be booked at the hotel reception.
Please check in online 24 hours before each flight and arrive at the airport at least three hours before international departures.
